reports.title: Gempa Bumi M 7,7 Kab. Nagekeo, Nusa Tenggara Timur
reports.subtitle: BNPB Infographic — Update 16 Agustus 2026, Pkl. 21.00 WIB (Report No. 03/U2100/Gem-NgkNTT/BNPB/16082026)
reports.description: Official BNPB single-page infographic: 9 regencies + 1 city affected across NTT, NTB and South Sulawesi; 54 deaths, 199 injured, 9,963 displaced, 1,528 households affected; 2,403 houses damaged (1,543 heavy/328 moderate/532 light); province-wide facility damage (110 education, 65 places of worship, 211 health facilities, 105 government offices, 1 Bulog warehouse, 18 irrigation facilities, 42 public facilities, 34 road points); full emergency-status decree citations for 8 jurisdictions; and an itemised urgent-needs list for 7 regencies.

reports.title: Gempa Bumi M 7,7 Kab. Nagekeo, Nusa Tenggara Timur
reports.subtitle: BNPB Infographic — Update 17 Agustus 2026, Pkl. 07.00 WIB (PUSDATINKOM BNPB Report No. 04/U0700/Gem-NgkNTT/BNPB/17082026)
reports.description: Newest official BNPB single-page infographic, superseding Report No. 03: 56 deaths, 277 injured, 11,675 displaced, 1,528 households affected; 4,674 houses damaged (2,806 heavy/727 moderate/1,141 light); province-wide facility damage (254 education, 96 places of worship, 211 health facilities [21 hospitals + 190 puskesmas], 106 government offices, 1 Bulog warehouse, 1 irrigation facility, 97 public facilities, 34 road points); 1,576 BMKG-recorded aftershocks; an eight-point 'Upaya' (measures) summary; a new precautionary coastal self-evacuation advisory; and confirmation of regency-level emergency-status decrees.

reports.title: Gempa Bumi M 7,7 Kab. Nagekeo, Nusa Tenggara Timur
reports.subtitle: BNPB Infographic — Update 18 Agustus 2026, Pkl. 09.00 WIB (PUSDATINKOM BNPB Report No. 05/U0900/Gem-NgkNTT/BNPB/18082026)
reports.description: Newest official BNPB single-page infographic, third in this series: 70 deaths, 665 injured, 31,220 displaced, 16,411 households affected; 12,153 houses damaged (6,578 heavy/1,660 moderate/3,915 light); province-wide facility damage (264 education, 157 places of worship, 83 health facilities [9 hospitals + 74 puskesmas — a sharp drop from 211], 171 government offices, 1 Bulog warehouse, 7 irrigation facilities, 116 public facilities, 34 road points, plus newly-tracked 1 market and 5 bridges); a nine-point 'Upaya' summary including new health-team deployments, excavator deployments, telecom (95.4% BTS operational) and electricity (93.1% distribution substations restored) recovery status.

briefings.title: Update on conditions and response following the M7.7 earthquake in Nagekeo

media_updates.title: Update Gempa NTT: 47 Meninggal, Lebih dari 5.000 Orang Mengungsi
media_updates.description: Carries BNPB's 00:00 WIB, 16 August update: revised district death distribution, first detailed evacuee counts by site, and province-wide damage figures. Primary source for this SitRep's latest impact.json update.

media_updates.title: 611 Gempa Susulan Guncang NTT
media_updates.description: BMKG aftershock count as of 02:00 WIB, 16 August: 611 aftershocks, M1.9-M6.2, 16 above M5, 30 felt. Quotes BMKG Head Prof. Ir. Teuku Faisal Fathani on the sequence not yet decaying.

media_updates.title: Badan Geologi: Ada Indikasi Likuefaksi pada Gempa di NTT
media_updates.description: Badan Geologi (ESDM) preliminary indication of liquefaction (sand boils) at Waekokak, Mbay, Nagekeo; low-to-moderate assessed severity.

media_updates.title: NTT Berstatus Tanggap Darurat Bencana Pascagempa M 7,7
media_updates.description: NTT provincial 14-day emergency-response decree in process; Manggarai Regency's 90-day declaration confirmed.

media_updates.title: PLN Sebut 88 Persen Kelistrikan di Pulau Flores Sudah Normal Usai Gempa
media_updates.description: PLN President Director Darmawan Prasodjo on electricity restoration progress across Flores.

media_updates.title: Gempa Flores, BPBD NTT Rinci Kerusakan Awal Pelabuhan Maumere Hingga Rumah Warga
media_updates.description: BPBD NTT (Mahadin Sibarani) initial infrastructure damage assessment across Flores.

media_updates.title: BPBD NTB mencatat sejumlah kerusakan bangunan akibat gempa NTT
media_updates.description: Cross-province damage in Bima City and Bima Regency, West Nusa Tenggara, reported by BPBD NTB (Sadimin).

media_updates.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake hits Indonesia, killing at least 47
media_updates.description: International coverage citing USGS shaking-exposure estimates and Reuters eyewitness reporting.

media_updates.title: Magnitude-7.7 quake hits off coast of Indonesia, killing at least 47
media_updates.description: AP wire coverage including comparison to the December 1992 Flores earthquake and tsunami (~2,500 deaths).

media_updates.title: Tangani Gempa M 7,7 Flores, Kepala BNPB Instruksikan Delapan Langkah Strategis Penanganan Darurat
media_updates.description: BNPB Head Letjen TNI Dr. Suharyanto's eight-point directive from a Manggarai Barat coordination meeting: emergency-status declarations, posko command structure (Labuan Bajo/Maumere), the Halim Perdanakusuma national logistics posko, Basarnas-led SAR, a 7-day basic-service restoration target, cross-agency air/sea assets, and daily 17:00 WITA media briefings. Primary source for this SitRep's response_coordination update.

media_updates.title: Kemenkes targetkan RSUD terdampak gempa NTT pulih dalam sepekan
media_updates.description: Kepala Pusat Krisis Kesehatan Kemenkes Agus Jamaludin on hospital and puskesmas recovery targets: RSUD basic services within a week (trauma, maternal-child, haemodialysis), a mobile hospital for RSUD Nagekeo, and damaged puskesmas resuming at least minimum operation (maternal health, childbirth, immunisation) within two weeks. Primary source for this SitRep's health.json recovery_targets update.

media_updates.title: Dampak Gempa NTT, Menkes: 6 Puskesmas dan 2 RS Rusak Berat
media_updates.description: Menteri Kesehatan Budi Gunadi Sadikin's verbal facility-damage estimate, retained separately from the Health Crisis Center's tabulated figures (see health.json's puskesmas_severe_damage_discrepancy).

media_updates.title: 14 Fasilitas Kesehatan di Kabupaten Ngada Terdampak Gempa NTT, Puskesmas Butuh Tenda Darurat
media_updates.description: BPBD Ngada Pusdalops district-level detail: 14 health facilities affected (puskesmas, RSUD, posyandu), including Puskesmas Maronggela reported in need of an emergency tent.
